intent.raw_query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA

experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join a guided sunrise yoga session along the scenic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud. This gentle hike followed by an open-air yoga class offers stunning valley views and a deeply spiritual start to the day. Ideal for Day 2 onward since the flight arrives late on Day 1. Choose a hotel in central Ubud to walk to the trailhead within minutes.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset & Surf Lesson
experiences.description: Take a beginner surf lesson at Seminyak Beach in the late afternoon, then relax and watch the famous Bali sunset. Seminyak is a central hub with many beachfront hotels nearby, minimizing travel time. Booking a hotel in Seminyak or Kuta ensures you can walk to the beach, making this a practical daily activity throughout your 13-day stay.

experiences.name: Nusa Dua Snorkeling & Beach Club Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day snorkeling in the crystal-clear waters of Nusa Dua, followed by relaxing at a beachfront club. Nusa Dua offers calm, reef-protected waters perfect for snorkeling. Staying in nearby Nusa Dua or Jimbaran keeps transfer times under 15 minutes, making this a stress-free full-day beach experience well within budget.

experiences.name: Ubud Traditional Balinese Cooking Class
experiences.description: Join a hands-on cooking class in central Ubud where a local chef guides you through preparing authentic Balinese dishes using fresh market ingredients. Classes typically begin with a morning market visit. Staying in central Ubud means the class venue is often within walking distance, eliminating costly and time-consuming transfers.

experiences.name: Tirta Empul Temple Purification & Cultural Tour
experiences.description: Participate in a traditional Balinese purification ritual at the sacred Tirta Empul water temple, one of Bali's most spiritually significant sites. A local guide explains the cultural and religious significance of each step. This experience pairs well with a stay in Ubud, which is only 15 minutes away, making it easy to visit without long travel days.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Bali
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No morning activities — flight arrives at 13:00. Rest and prepare for landing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00. Clear customs, collect luggage, and take a pre-booked airport shuttle or shared Grab car to Ubud Boutique Stay (approx. 1.5–2 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and take a slow walk along Monkey Forest Road to get oriented.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll through central Ubud — explore the Ubud Art Market stalls (open late) for a feel of local crafts. Settle in early to recover from travel.

meals.breakfast: Eat on the plane or grab a snack at the airport.
meals.lunch: Skip or grab a quick bite at the airport — Indomaret convenience store meal (~IDR 25,000).
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah on Jl. Goutama — authentic Balinese nasi campur for ~IDR 35,000–50,000.

day_by_day.notes: Use Grab app for affordable transport from airport. Agree on price before entering any non-metered taxi. Exchange some cash at airport or use ATM in Ubud — avoid hotel exchange rates.

day_by_day.morning: Join a free or donation-based morning yoga class at Yoga Barn (Ubud) — early session starts at 07:30. Alternatively, do a self-guided yoga session in your hotel room. Afterward, walk to Campuhan Ridge Walk (free) for a scenic 2 km ridge trail through lush greenery — best done before 09:30 to beat the heat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — free to view from outside, small entry for inner courtyard. Explore the Ubud Traditional Art Market for budget souvenirs. Browse without pressure to buy.
day_by_day.evening: Watch a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud (~IDR 100,000–150,000) — an unmissable cultural experience.

meals.breakfast: Warung Teges — nasi goreng or bubur ayam for ~IDR 20,000–30,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Oka — famous babi guling (suckling pig) ~IDR 50,000–70,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Sopa on Jl. Sugriwa — vegetarian Balinese food, budget-friendly ~IDR 40,000–60,000.

day_by_day.notes: Campuhan Ridge Walk is completely free and one of Ubud's best hidden gems. Bring water and sunscreen. Kecak performances vary by venue — check schedules at the hotel.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise visit to Tegallalang Rice Terraces (~IDR 15,000 entry). Arrive by 07:00 for golden light and fewer crowds. Walk the terraced paths and enjoy the iconic views. Opt for a short guided walk with a local farmer (~IDR 20,000 tip).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Tirta Empul Temple — a sacred Hindu water temple with purification pools (~IDR 50,000 entry). Dress respectfully (sarong provided). Afterward, stop at a local coffee plantation for a free tasting of Bali's famous Luwak coffee.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Relax with an affordable traditional Balinese massage (~IDR 80,000–120,000/hr at a local spa on Jl. Hanoman).

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel if breakfast is included, or try a local warung — pisang goreng and tea ~IDR 15,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Tegallalang — nasi campur ~IDR 35,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Mendez — grilled fish and rice ~IDR 45,000–65,000.

day_by_day.notes: Rent a scooter (~IDR 70,000–80,000/day) to reach Tegallalang and Tirta Empul independently and save on transport. Wear a helmet at all times. Sarongs are required at temples — usually provided for free or small fee.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga session at The Yoga Barn (drop-in class ~IDR 120,000) or a free outdoor session at your hotel. Afterward, visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum (~IDR 80,000) — a stunning artist's home and gallery set above the Campuhan river.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the village of Penestanan (Ubud's 'Painter's Village') on foot — free to wander. Browse local art galleries and watch artisans at work. Visit Neka Art Museum (~IDR 75,000) for an overview of Balinese painting styles.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free temple ceremony if one is happening in the area (ask hotel staff). Evening walk along Jl. Monkey Forest — vibrant with local life after dark.

meals.breakfast: Kopi Joss or local warung — coffee and banana pancakes ~IDR 25,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Bernadette — local Balinese set meal ~IDR 40,000.
meals.dinner: Locavore To Go (budget arm of famous Locavore) — quality local street food ~IDR 50,000–80,000.

day_by_day.notes: July is a dry month in Ubud — ideal for walking. Keep small change (IDR 10,000–20,000 notes) for temple donations and warung payments.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Mount Batur volcano. Join a budget group sunrise trek (~IDR 350,000–450,000 including guide) — depart Ubud by 02:00, reach summit by sunrise (~05:30). The panoramic views over the caldera lake are spectacular.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and soak tired muscles at natural hot springs at Toya Devasya (~IDR 150,000 entry) near Lake Batur. Relax and recharge.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud by late afternoon. Rest and do gentle stretching or yoga. Early dinner and early night to recover.

meals.breakfast: Snack bar and hot tea at the volcano summit — usually included in trek package.
meals.lunch: Local warung near Lake Batur — grilled corn, noodles ~IDR 30,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Enak — simple Balinese home cooking ~IDR 40,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Batur trek through your hotel or a local agent the day before to get the best group price. Bring a warm layer — summit temperature can drop to 10–15°C before sunrise. This is a long day — start rest early.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Gentle yoga or meditation session at The Yoga Barn or hotel. Walk to a local market — Pasar Ubud morning market is most active before 08:00. Browse fresh tropical fruits, local snacks, and flowers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave Temple) — ~IDR 50,000 entry, located just 3 km from Ubud center. Explore the ancient cave shrine, bathing pools, and jungle ravine. Combine with a short walk to the nearby Yeh Pulu rock carvings (free).
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks at a rooftop café on Jl. Raya Ubud — order a fresh coconut or local Bintang beer (~IDR 30,000–50,000). Watch the town wind down.

meals.breakfast: Fresh fruit salad and jaffles from the morning market ~IDR 20,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Goa Gajah — nasi goreng ~IDR 30,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Murni — one of Ubud's oldest warungs, river view, ~IDR 50,000–70,000.

day_by_day.notes: Goa Gajah is walkable or a short scooter ride from Ubud center. Sarong required. The morning market is best visited before 07:30 for the most authentic experience before tourist crowds arrive.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day: depart Ubud for the beach region. Take a shared shuttle (~IDR 80,000–100,000) to Seminyak or Canggu. Check into a budget guesthouse or hostel (~IDR 150,000–250,000/night). Drop bags and head straight to the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on Batu Bolong Beach (Canggu) — free, uncrowded compared to Kuta, with great surf energy. Rent a surfboard and take a beginner surf lesson (~IDR 150,000–200,000 including board). The warm July water is ideal.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the legendary Bali sunset from the beach. Walk to Old Man's Beach Bar — iconic Canggu sunset spot. Budget-friendly drinks and live music.

meals.breakfast: Eat before leaving Ubud — hotel breakfast or local warung.
meals.lunch: Warung near Batu Bolong — fresh grilled fish and rice ~IDR 45,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Dandelion or a local spot in Canggu — ~IDR 50,000–70,000.

day_by_day.notes: Canggu is more budget-friendly and laid-back than Seminyak. Book accommodation in advance for July (peak season). Batu Bolong and Echo Beach are both free and walkable from most Canggu guesthouses.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga on the beach or join a drop-in class at Desa Seni yoga studio (~IDR 130,000). Afterward, rent a bicycle (~IDR 50,000/day) and explore Canggu's rice paddies and back lanes — a peaceful contrast to beach life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Tanah Lot Temple — one of Bali's most iconic sea temples (~IDR 60,000 entry). Perched on a rocky outcrop, best visited 1–2 hours before sunset. Explore the surrounding clifftop paths and temple grounds.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the dramatic sunset over Tanah Lot — one of the best in Bali. Return to Canggu for dinner.

meals.breakfast: Betelnut Café — açaí bowl or smoothie bowl ~IDR 60,000–80,000 (a Canggu staple).
meals.lunch: Local warung in Canggu — nasi campur ~IDR 35,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Sunset Road — grilled seafood platter ~IDR 60,000–80,000.

day_by_day.notes: Tanah Lot is ~20 minutes by scooter from Canggu. Hire a scooter for the day (~IDR 70,000) for flexibility. Sarong required at Tanah Lot — available for rent at the entrance.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning swim or surf at Echo Beach (Canggu) — popular with intermediate surfers. Alternatively, take a second surf lesson to build on Day 7 skills. The morning swell is typically best before 10:00.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Seminyak (15 min by scooter). Walk Seminyak Beach — wider and cleaner than Kuta. Browse the boutique shops on Jl. Kayu Aya (window shopping is free!). Visit Potato Head Beach Club for a look — free to enter the beach area outside peak hours.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Seminyak Beach. Dine on Jl. Laksmana (Eat Street) — dozens of warungs and mid-range restaurants competing for business, keeping prices reasonable.

meals.breakfast: Warung near Echo Beach — eggs, toast, coffee ~IDR 30,000.
meals.lunch: Nasi Bali Men Weti in Seminyak — authentic local lunch ~IDR 40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Taman Bambu — Balinese duck (bebek betutu) ~IDR 55,000–75,000.

day_by_day.notes: Seminyak is pricier than Canggu — stick to warungs off the main strip for budget meals. Jl. Laksmana (Eat Street) has good variety at competitive prices. Avoid beach vendors selling overpriced drinks.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Uluwatu. Rent a scooter (~IDR 70,000) and ride the scenic coastal road south (~45 min from Canggu). Visit Uluwatu Temple (~IDR 50,000) perched dramatically on a 70m cliff above the Indian Ocean. Explore the clifftop paths and watch monkeys.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend to Padang Padang Beach (~IDR 15,000 entry) — a stunning small cove beach. Swim, snorkel, or simply sunbathe on white sand. Walk to Bingin Beach (free) for a more secluded alternative.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Uluwatu for the Kecak Fire Dance at the clifftop amphitheater at sunset (~IDR 150,000) — arguably the most spectacular setting in Bali. Arrive 30 minutes early for a good seat.

meals.breakfast: Eat in Canggu before departing — local warung ~IDR 25,000.
meals.lunch: Single Fin Restaurant at Uluwatu — budget option is a beer and chips watching surfers ~IDR 60,000.
meals.dinner: Warung on the cliff road back toward Canggu — fresh grilled fish ~IDR 50,000.

day_by_day.notes: Hold tightly onto your belongings at Uluwatu Temple — monkeys are notorious thieves (especially sunglasses and phones). Padang Padang Beach requires climbing through a small cave entrance — wear appropriate footwear.

day_by_day.morning: Travel to Sanur (east coast) — take a shared shuttle or Grab (~IDR 80,000–120,000). Check in or drop bags. Walk the famous Sanur Beach Boardwalk (free, 5 km paved path along the beach) — calm, flat waters ideal for swimming. Rent a bicycle (~IDR 40,000) to cover the full boardwalk.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a short boat to Nusa Lembongan island (~IDR 125,000 one way, 30 min). Rent a bicycle or walk to Devil's Tears — a dramatic blowhole and cliff viewpoint (free). Swim at Mushroom Bay — clear, calm water perfect for snorkeling.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Sanur by late afternoon boat. Sunset walk along the beach promenade. Sanur is quieter and more local-feeling than Kuta or Seminyak.

meals.breakfast: Café Batu Jimbar in Sanur — healthy breakfast ~IDR 60,000–80,000.
meals.lunch: Warung on Nusa Lembongan — fresh tuna sandwich or nasi goreng ~IDR 40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Pantai Indah on Sanur Beach — fresh seafood BBQ ~IDR 60,000–80,000.

day_by_day.notes: Nusa Lembongan day trip is excellent value — boats depart Sanur Harbour from ~07:30. Confirm last return boat time (usually 17:00). Bring reef-safe sunscreen for snorkeling. Sanur is one of Bali's most underrated, budget-friendly beach areas.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga on Sanur Beach at sunrise — several free or donation-based sessions happen on the beach promenade. Afterward, visit the Museum Le Mayeur (~IDR 20,000) — a beautiful colonial-era home of a Belgian painter, right on the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Ubud or explore Denpasar — Bali's capital and most local city. Visit Pasar Badung (Denpasar's main market) for the most authentic, tourist-free shopping experience. Browse spices, textiles, and local produce. Visit Pura Jagatnatha temple (free) in the city center.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Bali — return to Ubud for a farewell dinner. Reflect on the trip with a Balinese traditional massage (~IDR 80,000–100,000) and a quiet dinner.

meals.breakfast: Fresh coconut and fruit from a beach vendor ~IDR 20,000.
meals.lunch: Warung in Denpasar market — most authentic and cheapest food in Bali ~IDR 20,000–30,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka (Ubud) — classic farewell Balinese feast ~IDR 60,000–80,000.

day_by_day.notes: Denpasar's Pasar Badung is best visited in the morning when it's most active. Bargain respectfully — start at 50% of asking price. Keep valuables secure in crowded market areas.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise yoga or meditation session in Ubud — Campuhan Ridge Walk at dawn (free) for a peaceful last morning in Bali. Pack up and check out of Ubud Boutique Stay. Leave luggage at reception if your flight is in the evening.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping at Ubud Art Market — sarongs, wooden carvings, and silver jewelry make great budget gifts. Negotiate prices. Take a final walk through Ubud center and say goodbye to the town.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange airport transfer (shared shuttle ~IDR 100,000–150,000 or Grab). Arrive at Ngurah Rai Airport with 2–3 hours to spare. Depart Bali.

meals.breakfast: Final Balinese breakfast at a local warung — nasi goreng, fresh juice ~IDR 30,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Teges or any trusted local spot — light lunch before travel ~IDR 35,000.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 2.5–3 hours for airport check-in during July peak season — Ngurah Rai can be very busy. Convert remaining IDR back to your home currency before departure (rates at airport are poor — use a Denpasar money changer if time allows). Keep a small amount of IDR for airport snacks and tips.

trip_options.title: Classic Bali Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Private transfer from airport to Ubud Boutique Stay (~1.5 hours). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle orientation stroll along Monkey Forest Road to get acquainted with the neighborhood, browse local art shops, and breathe in the lush surroundings
day_by_day.evening: Easy first night — explore the vibrant Ubud Night Market (Pasar Senggol) for an authentic introduction to Balinese street food and local crafts

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight
meals.lunch: Grab a light bite at the airport or a quick stop en route — try a local warung near Ubud center such as Warung Ibu Oka for a taste of babi guling (roasted pork)
meals.dinner: Ubud Night Market — sample satay, nasi campur, and fresh fruit for under IDR 80,000 per person

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light to recover from travel. Confirm hotel transfer in advance. Exchange some cash to IDR at the airport for market spending.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga class at a renowned Ubud studio such as Yoga Barn — join a 90-minute Hatha or Vinyasa class surrounded by jungle views (approx IDR 150,000–200,000)
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terraces (~20 min from Ubud) — walk the terraced paths, take in the sweeping views, and optionally try a short ATV ride through the paddies
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or Arma Museum amphitheater — a mesmerizing cultural experience (tickets ~IDR 100,000–150,000)

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or Kafe Ubud for smoothie bowls and avocado toast
meals.lunch: Warung Bodag Maliah near Tegallalang — local nasi goreng with jungle views
meals.dinner: Locavore NXT or Warung Babi Guling Pak Malen for a mid-range Balinese feast

day_by_day.notes: Book yoga class and Kecak performance in advance. Wear comfortable walking shoes for the rice terraces. Bring small bills for terrace entrance donations.

day_by_day.morning: Morning meditation and pranayama session at The Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive (~IDR 150,000). Afterward, visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary for a peaceful walk among ancient temples and playful macaques
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud Royal Palace (Puri Saren Agung) and the adjacent Ubud Art Market — browse handmade sarongs, silver jewelry, and wood carvings. Ideal for mid-range souvenir shopping
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a traditional Balinese massage at one of Ubud's reputable spas such as Karsa Spa or Fivelements (~IDR 200,000–350,000 for 60–90 min)

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio — specialty coffee and granola bowls in a stylish setting
meals.lunch: Warung Sopa — healthy vegetarian Balinese cuisine at very reasonable prices
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali — riverside dining with Indonesian and international dishes, mid-range pricing

day_by_day.notes: The Monkey Forest opens at 09:00. Keep bags secure around monkeys. Book spa treatment in advance for preferred time slot.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Besakih Temple (Mother Temple of Bali) — the largest and holiest Hindu temple on the island, set on the slopes of Mount Agung (~1.5 hours from Ubud). Hire a local guide for cultural context
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at Kintamani for panoramic views of Mount Batur and the caldera lake. Enjoy the volcanic landscape and visit a local coffee plantation for a luwak coffee tasting
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud and unwind with a yin yoga or restorative class at The Yoga Barn

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before early departure
meals.lunch: Restaurant Gunawan at Kintamani — buffet lunch with volcano views (~IDR 150,000–200,000)
meals.dinner: Naughty Nuri's Warung — famous for BBQ ribs and cold Bintang beer, lively atmosphere

day_by_day.notes: Wear a sarong at Besakih Temple (available for rent at entrance). Start by 08:00 to avoid midday heat. Hire a reputable driver for the full day (~IDR 500,000–700,000).

day_by_day.morning: Early morning sunrise hike at Mount Batur — depart Ubud by 03:30 AM, guided trek to the summit (2,152 m) to catch the sunrise above the clouds (~3 hours up). Tour operators charge ~IDR 400,000–600,000 including guide
day_by_day.afternoon: Soak in the natural hot springs at Toya Devasya or Batur Natural Hot Spring after the hike — perfect muscle recovery with caldera views
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud for a gentle restorative yoga session or simply rest and reflect at the hotel

meals.breakfast: Simple breakfast at the summit — guides typically bring eggs cooked in volcanic steam and bananas
meals.lunch: Late lunch at a warung near the hot springs — nasi campur and fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Clear Cafe Ubud — wholesome organic meals in a relaxed garden setting

day_by_day.notes: Book the Mount Batur sunrise trek at least 2 days in advance. Bring layers — summit temperatures can drop to 10°C before sunrise. Wear sturdy shoes. This is a strenuous day; rest well the night before.

day_by_day.morning: Recovery morning — gentle morning yoga at the hotel or a nearby studio. Then visit Tirta Empul Temple, the sacred water purification temple where locals and visitors participate in a melukat (holy water) cleansing ritual
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Gunung Kawi Temple — an 11th-century royal monument carved into a cliff face, surrounded by lush rice paddies and a river gorge. A peaceful and photogenic site
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Legong Dance performance at ARMA Museum — one of Bali's most refined classical dance forms

meals.breakfast: Juice Ja Cafe — fresh cold-pressed juices and acai bowls
meals.lunch: Warung near Gunung Kawi — simple local rice dishes with tempeh and vegetables
meals.dinner: Room4Dessert or Hujan Locale — creative Indonesian cuisine with a modern twist

day_by_day.notes: Bring a sarong for Tirta Empul (mandatory). The purification ritual is open to respectful visitors. Gunung Kawi involves a steep staircase descent — wear comfortable shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day: Transfer from Ubud to Seminyak/Canggu area (~1.5 hours) for a beach-focused interlude. Check into a mid-range beach guesthouse or surf lodge for 3 nights
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Echo Beach or Batu Bolong Beach in Canggu — swim, sunbathe, and watch local surfers. July weather brings excellent surf conditions
day_by_day.evening: Explore Canggu's vibrant beach club scene — visit La Brisa or Finn's Beach Club for a sundowner cocktail as the sun dips into the Indian Ocean

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure from Ubud
meals.lunch: Betelnut Cafe Canggu — fresh salads, burgers, and smoothies with a relaxed vibe
meals.dinner: Old Man's Canggu — lively open-air bar and restaurant with good food and cold beers

day_by_day.notes: Book Canggu accommodation in advance — July is peak season. Arrange a private driver or use Grab app for the transfer. Bring reef-safe sunscreen.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga on the beach or at Desa Seni eco-resort (open classes available, ~IDR 150,000). Followed by a surf lesson at Batu Bolong Beach — ideal for beginners and intermediates (~IDR 250,000–350,000 for 2-hour lesson)
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Tanah Lot Temple — one of Bali's most iconic sea temples perched on a rocky outcrop, accessible at low tide. Arrive in the afternoon before the sunset crowd peaks
day_by_day.evening: Watch the spectacular sunset at Tanah Lot with the temple silhouetted against the sky — one of Bali's most iconic views

meals.breakfast: Crate Cafe Canggu — famous for healthy bowls, eggs, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Warung near Batu Bolong — post-surf nasi goreng and fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Tanah Lot area restaurant or return to Canggu for dinner at Monsieur Spoon — French-inspired bakery and bistro

day_by_day.notes: Check tide times for Tanah Lot — the rock is accessible on foot only at low tide. Sarong required for temple entry. Book surf lesson the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Morning beach walk along Seminyak Beach followed by a visit to Potato Head Beach Club for a late morning swim in their iconic pool overlooking the ocean (day pass or minimum spend applies)
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Seminyak's boutique shopping strip — browse Jalan Laksmana (Eat Street) and Jalan Kayu Aya for unique Balinese fashion, homeware, and jewelry. Great for mid-range shopping
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Ku De Ta or Merah Putih restaurant — enjoy cocktails and modern Indonesian cuisine as the sky turns gold

meals.breakfast: Revolver Espresso Seminyak — top-notch coffee and light breakfast in a hidden alley cafe
meals.lunch: Nalu Bowls Seminyak — healthy poke and acai bowls at great prices
meals.dinner: Merah Putih Restaurant — stunning two-story bamboo interior with refined Indonesian dishes (mid-to-upper mid-range)

day_by_day.notes: Seminyak is more upscale than Canggu — slightly higher prices. Use Grab for short transfers between areas. Negotiate prices politely when shopping at boutiques.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Uluwatu — visit the dramatic clifftop Pura Luhur Uluwatu Temple perched 70 meters above the Indian Ocean. Explore the surrounding walkways and spot wild monkeys
day_by_day.afternoon: Head down to Padang Padang Beach or Bingin Beach — two of Bali's most beautiful hidden beaches with turquoise water and white sand. Swim and relax
day_by_day.evening: Watch the legendary Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Temple at sunset — performed on an open-air cliff stage with the ocean as a backdrop (tickets ~IDR 150,000)

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Single Fin Uluwatu — casual beach bar perched above Uluwatu surf break with great burgers and views
meals.dinner: Warung near Jimbaran Bay — fresh grilled seafood on the beach (jimbaran-style BBQ, ~IDR 150,000–250,000 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Uluwatu is ~45 min from Canggu. Keep bags tightly closed around temple monkeys. Book Kecak performance tickets early. Arrive at Jimbaran before 19:00 for the best beach table.

day_by_day.morning: Transfer back to Ubud (~1.5 hours) for the final Ubud segment. Morning arrival — drop bags at hotel and visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum, home to the flamboyant works of Don Antonio Blanco, set in a stunning jungle estate
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a Balinese cooking class — a hands-on half-day experience learning to prepare dishes like satay lilit, lawar, and black rice pudding using local market ingredients (~IDR 350,000–500,000)
day_by_day.evening: Leisurely evening walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk — a scenic ridge trail through green hills and jungle, beautiful in the late afternoon golden light

meals.breakfast: Grab something light en route from Canggu — Bali Buda bakery in Ubud on arrival
meals.lunch: Cooking class lunch — eat what you cook!
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant — one of Ubud's finest dining experiences with French-Indonesian tasting menus (splurge night)

day_by_day.notes: Book cooking class in advance — popular classes fill quickly in July. Campuhan Ridge Walk is best done before 17:30 to enjoy the sunset light. Wear insect repellent.

day_by_day.morning: Final yoga session in Ubud — choose a special class such as a sound healing meditation or aerial yoga at Radiantly Alive or The Yoga Barn (~IDR 150,000–200,000)
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Pura Tirta Empul if not done earlier, or explore the lesser-visited Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave) — an ancient 9th-century sanctuary with carved stone entrance and bathing pools
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Tegallalang Rice Terraces — the golden hour light over the terraces is magical. Enjoy a farewell Bali Sling cocktail at a terrace cafe overlooking the paddies

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio — final specialty coffee ritual
meals.lunch: Warung Pulau Kelapa — generous local buffet with rotating Balinese dishes
meals.dinner: Alchemy Ubud — fully raw vegan restaurant with creative dishes, a unique Ubud experience

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to purchase any last-minute gifts or souvenirs at Ubud Art Market. Pack bags in the evening for an organized departure. Confirm airport transfer for Day 13.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise meditation or gentle walk through Ubud's quiet streets before the town wakes up. Visit a local temple ceremony if one is happening nearby — a serene final memory of Bali
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out from Ubud Boutique Stay and transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport (~1.5 hours). Allow at least 3 hours before departure for international flights. Browse duty-free for Balinese coffee, chocolate, or spices
day_by_day.evening: Departure — carry home memories of yoga, temples, rice terraces, beaches, and the warmth of Balinese culture

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast or Kafe Ubud for one last smoothie bowl
meals.lunch: Light meal at the airport — Puri Selera restaurant in the departure terminal serves decent Indonesian food
meals.dinner: In-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Bali's airport can be busy in July — arrive with plenty of time. Keep IDR for last-minute tips and small purchases. Declare any food items at customs in your destination country. Safe travels!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Bali Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Private airport transfer to Ubud Boutique Stay in Ubud (approx. 1.5 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink and orientation tour of the property. Settle into your luxury suite and relax by the private pool.
day_by_day.evening: Gentle introductory stroll through Ubud's central market area and Jalan Monkey Forest at dusk. Explore the atmospheric streets lined with boutiques and galleries as the town comes alive in the evening.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in-flight or airport meal
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Dinner at Locavore, Ubud's acclaimed farm-to-table fine dining restaurant. Seasonal tasting menu with paired natural wines. Advance reservation essential.

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private air-conditioned car transfer in advance. Keep Day 1 light to recover from travel. Request early check-in if possible.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session at the hotel's open-air shala overlooking the jungle canopy (6:30–8:00 AM). Follow with a nourishing breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, visit the sacred Tirta Empul Temple for a cultural immersion and optional purification ritual.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided tour of the Tegallalang Rice Terraces with a local expert. Walk the terraced paths, learn about the traditional Subak irrigation system, and enjoy sweeping views over the emerald landscape. Stop at a local artisan workshop for a hands-on Balinese craft experience.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at Kafe Batan Waru rooftop terrace. Enjoy panoramic views over the Ubud valley as the sky turns golden.

meals.breakfast: Elaborate Indonesian breakfast spread at the hotel — fresh tropical fruits, nasi goreng, jamu wellness shots
meals.lunch: Alfresco lunch at Sari Organik, a farm-to-table restaurant set amid the rice fields of Ubud
meals.dinner: Dinner at Hujan Locale — modern Indonesian cuisine in a beautifully restored colonial setting

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable walking shoes for the rice terraces. A sarong is required for temple visits — usually available to borrow on-site.

day_by_day.morning: Private Vinyasa yoga class at sunrise followed by a Balinese healing session with a traditional healer (Balian) — a deeply spiritual and unique Bali experience. Return to the hotel for a full Balinese massage at the in-house spa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud Royal Palace (Puri Saren Agung) and the nearby Ubud Art Market. Browse handcrafted textiles, woodcarvings, and silver jewelry. Visit the Neka Art Museum to discover Balinese and Indonesian fine art collections.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Ubud Palace — a mesmerizing open-air spectacle performed at dusk.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast: smoothie bowls, avocado toast, and cold-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Lunch at Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique — Michelin-recommended fine dining with a French-Indonesian fusion menu
meals.dinner: Private candlelit dinner arranged by the hotel in a jungle-side pavilion (pre-book with concierge)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Kecak Dance performance in advance — seats fill quickly during peak season. The Balian session should be arranged through a reputable cultural guide.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning Yin yoga and meditation session by the hotel pool (6:30 AM). Private guided cycling tour through Ubud's countryside — pedal past rice paddies, traditional villages, and ancient temples in the cool morning air.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave) archaeological site and the nearby Yeh Pulu rock carvings. Continue to the Pura Kehen Temple in Bangli for a quieter, less-touristed spiritual experience.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a traditional Balinese cooking class at a luxury villa kitchen — learn to prepare signature dishes like bebek betutu and lawar under the guidance of a master chef.

meals.breakfast: Healthy hotel breakfast: acai bowls, granola, tropical fruits, herbal teas
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch prepared by the hotel and enjoyed in the rice fields during the cycling tour
meals.dinner: Dine on the dishes you prepared in the cooking class, enjoyed in a garden setting with Balinese rice wine

day_by_day.notes: Cycling tour difficulty is moderate — suitable for most fitness levels. Bring sunscreen and a hat for the afternoon temple visits.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga and pranayama breathwork session at the hotel (6:00 AM). Full-morning visit to the majestic Besakih Temple (Mother Temple of Bali) — Bali's largest and holiest Hindu temple complex on the slopes of Mount Agung.
day_by_day.afternoon: Scenic drive to the Kintamani volcanic highlands. Enjoy panoramic views over the caldera of Mount Batur and the turquoise Lake Batur. Optional short hike around the crater rim with a private guide.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Unwind with a 90-minute Balinese boreh body scrub and flower bath at the hotel spa.

meals.breakfast: Light hotel breakfast before departure: fresh fruit, yogurt, and herbal infusions
meals.lunch: Lunch at Lakeview Eco Lodge Restaurant in Kintamani — spectacular caldera views paired with a Balinese buffet
meals.dinner: Dinner at Room4Dessert by Will Goldfarb — avant-garde dessert-forward tasting menu, a unique culinary experience

day_by_day.notes: Besakih Temple requires a guide and respectful attire. Depart early (by 7:30 AM) to avoid midday crowds. The Kintamani area can be slightly cooler — bring a light layer.

day_by_day.morning: Morning restorative yoga session at the hotel. Transfer to Seminyak/Petitenget beach area (approx. 1.5 hrs by private car). Check into a luxury beach club day pass. Enjoy a beachside swim and sun lounger session at Potato Head Beach Club.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a private surf lesson with a certified instructor on Seminyak Beach — ideal beginner-to-intermediate waves. After surfing, explore the upscale boutiques and galleries along Jalan Petitenget.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks at Ku De Ta beach club — one of Bali's most iconic sunset venues. Watch the sky transform over the Indian Ocean with a craft cocktail in hand.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Beachside lunch at Potato Head Beach Club — fresh seafood, salads, and tropical cocktails
meals.dinner: Dinner at Sardine, Seminyak — elegant open-air restaurant surrounded by rice fields, specializing in fresh seafood

day_by_day.notes: Return to Ubud hotel in the evening (private transfer arranged). This is a full-day excursion — pack beach essentials, reef-safe sunscreen, and a change of clothes.

day_by_day.morning: Full rest and wellness morning at the hotel. Begin with a guided meditation and sound healing session (singing bowls) in the hotel's jungle shala. Follow with a luxurious two-hour spa journey: hot stone massage, herbal compress treatment, and scalp ritual.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely afternoon exploring Penestanan village — Ubud's vibrant artist colony. Visit local painters' studios, browse contemporary Balinese art, and discover hidden cafés and rice field walks off the tourist trail.
day_by_day.evening: Private rooftop stargazing experience arranged by the hotel, paired with Balinese tapas and sparkling wine.

meals.breakfast: Luxurious in-room breakfast: tropical fruit platter, eggs benedict, fresh-pressed juices, Balinese coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at Bridges Bali — stunning clifftop restaurant over the Campuhan River gorge, serving international fine cuisine
meals.dinner: Intimate dinner at Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique — chef's table experience with a personalized tasting menu (advance booking required)

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is intentionally paced for rest and rejuvenation. This is the midpoint of the trip — an ideal moment to slow down and absorb the Balinese atmosphere.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise Ashtanga yoga class at a prestigious Ubud yoga studio (e.g., The Yoga Barn). Afterward, visit the Campuhan Ridge Walk — a scenic 2 km trail along a jungle ridge with sweeping valley views, best enjoyed in the cool morning hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private silver jewelry-making workshop with a Balinese artisan in Celuk village — create your own bespoke keepsake. Continue to Sukawati Art Market for a curated browse of traditional Balinese crafts.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Legong Dance performance at Puri Saren — an elegant classical Balinese dance form performed by young female dancers in elaborate costumes.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga breakfast at Clear Café Ubud — organic, plant-based menu with superfood bowls and raw desserts
meals.lunch: Lunch at Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka — legendary Balinese suckling pig, a true local institution
meals.dinner: Dinner at Alaya Resort's Plantation restaurant — refined Indonesian cuisine in a lush garden setting

day_by_day.notes: The Campuhan Ridge Walk is best before 8:30 AM to avoid heat. Wear light, breathable clothing. The silver workshop takes approximately 2 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga and meditation on the banks of the Ayung River (arranged through the hotel). Full-day white-water rafting experience on the Ayung River — navigate through lush jungle gorges and past ancient stone carvings with a professional guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-rafting relaxation at a riverside spa. Enjoy a traditional Balinese massage in an open-air bale overlooking the river.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Explore the vibrant night atmosphere of Jalan Dewi Sita — browse art galleries and boutique shops before dinner.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the hotel before the river excursion
meals.lunch: Riverside lunch included with the rafting package — traditional Balinese buffet at the rafting base camp
meals.dinner: Dinner at Elephant Restaurant, Ubud — stunning jungle-view terrace, farm-to-table menu with local ingredients

day_by_day.notes: White-water rafting is suitable for beginners — no prior experience required. All safety equipment provided. Bring a waterproof bag for valuables and a change of clothes.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga flow session at the hotel. Private transfer to Amed on Bali's northeast coast (approx. 2 hrs). Amed is renowned for its pristine coral reefs and the famous USAT Liberty shipwreck — one of the world's top wreck dive sites.
day_by_day.afternoon: Guided snorkeling or scuba diving session at the Liberty Wreck in Tulamben. The wreck is accessible directly from the beach and teems with colorful marine life. Explore the black volcanic sand beaches of Amed afterward.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks at a clifftop beach bar in Amed overlooking Mount Agung across the water. Enjoy the tranquil, unspoiled atmosphere of this quieter part of Bali.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood lunch at a beachfront warung in Amed — grilled fish, prawn satay, and coconut water
meals.dinner: Dinner at Santai Hotel Restaurant, Amed — Mediterranean-influenced menu with fresh local catch, candlelit beachside setting

day_by_day.notes: Return to Ubud hotel in the evening via private transfer. This is a long day — depart by 7:00 AM to maximize time at the coast. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and underwater camera.

day_by_day.morning: Optional pre-dawn Mount Batur volcano trek (depart 3:00 AM) — hike to the summit (1,717 m) to witness a breathtaking sunrise above the clouds with a certified guide. Return to the hotel by late morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Recovery afternoon at the hotel spa — full-body Balinese massage and a nourishing body wrap. Alternatively, enjoy a leisurely pool session and afternoon tea served in the hotel garden.
day_by_day.evening: Private cultural dinner experience: a Balinese family hosts you for a traditional home-cooked meal in their compound, with offerings ceremony and storytelling.

meals.breakfast: Packed breakfast provided during the volcano trek (sandwiches, fruit, hot tea/coffee at the summit)
meals.lunch: Late brunch at the hotel upon return — eggs royale, fresh juices, pastries
meals.dinner: Traditional Balinese home dining experience (arranged by concierge) — lawar, sate lilit, black rice pudding

day_by_day.notes: The Mount Batur trek is moderately challenging — good fitness required. Warm layers are essential at the summit (temperature can drop to 10°C). Book a certified guide through the hotel.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning yoga and pranayama session at the hotel shala — a reflective, closing practice to integrate the journey. Visit the stunning Pura Tirta Empul once more for a private sunrise blessing ceremony arranged through a local priest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Luxury shopping afternoon in Ubud — visit high-end boutiques for Balinese textiles, handmade jewelry, and artisan goods. Explore Threads of Life gallery for ethically sourced traditional ikat and batik textiles. Stop at a premium chocolate and coffee plantation for a tasting tour.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell sunset cocktail experience at a private villa terrace overlooking the jungle. Followed by a grand farewell dinner celebrating the journey.

meals.breakfast: Celebratory hotel breakfast: full tropical spread, fresh coconut, Balinese black rice porridge, fresh-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Lunch at Swept Away at COMO Shambhala Estate — health-focused gourmet cuisine in a stunning riverside jungle setting
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at Locavore — full chef's tasting menu with premium wine pairing, 8 courses

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing this evening. Confirm departure transfer time with concierge. Keep receipts for any artisan purchases for customs declaration.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise yoga or gentle stretch session on the hotel terrace. Enjoy a leisurely last breakfast at the hotel. Complete check-out formalities and collect any stored luggage.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport. Allow at least 3 hours before departure for check-in and immigration. Browse duty-free for last-minute Balinese souvenirs — Kopi Luwak coffee, Balinese sea salt, artisan chocolates.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Bali. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days of beaches, yoga, culture, and luxury in the Island of the Gods.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast — enjoy every last bite of the tropical spread
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the airport's premium lounge or a café near the departure gate
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Check-out time is typically 12:00 noon — arrange a late check-out if your flight departs in the late afternoon or evening. Tip hotel staff as a gesture of appreciation for exceptional service.

query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA
